title: Erroneous Payments of CPF Housing Grants as Highlighted in Auditor-General's Report for FY2020/2021
what_it_is: Erroneous Payments of CPF Housing Grants as Highlighted in Auditor-General's Report for FY2020/2021

sections.label: HDB resale grant audit findings
sections.summary: AGO checked 22,627 resale applications and found HDB disbursed grants to 13 ineligible applicants and 12 who failed to declare material information.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The Auditor-General's Office (AGO) checked a total of 22,627 resale applications with the Family or Singles Grant approved by HDB between 1 April 2018 and 30 September 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: AGO found that HDB had disbursed grants to 13 applicants who did not meet the eligibility criteria.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Further investigations revealed that the grants were wrongly disbursed for the remaining 12 applicants because the applicants had failed to declare material information such as their actual income and private property ownership to HDB.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: HDB has taken immediate action to recover the grants that were disbursed to ineligible applicants and is working to verify the eligibility status of the remaining 1,055 applicants flagged by AGO.

sections.label: Process improvements and IT infrastructure
sections.summary: More process improvements and central IT infrastructure and common services will be deployed to facilitate regular reviews.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: As I had indicated in my earlier answer, what we are doing is to have more process improvements and to deploy more central IT infrastructure and common services to facilitate regular reviews.

sections.label: Public Service conduct and integrity platforms
sections.summary: The Public Service uses sharing sessions and training to educate officers on personal conduct and integrity, and leaders emphasise misconduct is not condoned.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The Public Service has in place platforms such as sharing sessions and training programmes to educate and engage the officers on the importance of maintaining the high standards of personal conduct and upholding the integrity of the Public Service.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: And the leaders in the Public Service will continue to emphasise to their officers that misconduct is viewed seriously and will not be condoned; and will also remind them that there are internal avenues to report wrongdoing and fraudulent acts, if these occur and if the reporting is made in good faith.

sections.label: Contract variation review disclosures
sections.summary: Appropriate disclosures will be made after the review and resolutions on remaining contract variation issues are completed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth and Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: When we have completed the review and made the resolutions on the remaining contract variation issues that we will look at for the remaining contracts, we will make the appropriate disclosures.

sections.label: Completion of 1,055 cases
sections.summary: The 1,055 cases should be completed by or before the year-end, and reporting back will be done.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: On the second query, of the 1,055 cases, we think we should be able to complete it by or before the year-end.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And as to whether we will report back, the answer is yes.

sections.label: Ernst & Young review timeline
sections.summary: The review will be done as expeditiously as possible, and results will be shared with the public after completion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: To Ms Joan Pereira's second question, we expect to do it in as expeditious a manner as possible.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: But without having come into the details, I do not want to constrain the professionals from Ernst & Young as well.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: At some stage after we have completed the review itself, we will then share that with the public as well.
